'''Zorneth's Herdship''' belonged to the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Zorneth]]. It was crewed by Ithorians and assorted other [[Species/Legends|species]], along with numerous [[Droid/Legends|droids]], including [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[PDA6]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. A passenger aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] botanist [[Klorr Vilia]].

The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Targonn/Legends|Targonn]] with a cargo of live [[thookah]], whose coats Zorneth intended to sell. The starship was attacked by the forces of Dictator-Forever [[Craw]].
